QuestInfo.name: [Water Wars] Hydro-pocalypse Now
QuestInfo.0: It seems your presence is urgently requested by the Empress. Talk to Cygnus.
QuestInfo.1: It seems your presence is urgently requested by the Empress. Talk to Cygnus.
QuestInfo.2: Empress Cygnus says a water gun festival is to be held to ease tensions between the Cygnus Knights and the Resistance. The two factions forged an alliance as a result of the Black Heaven incident.
